title: Ecclesiastes
author: Traditionally associated with Solomon, identified as the Preacher, son of David, king in Jerusalem.
audience: God's people, warning them against life pursued apart from God.
historicalSetting: Ecclesiastes considers the vanity of life under the sun and calls people to fear God in the midst of life's limits and mysteries.
keyVerse: Ecclesiastes 12:13 — "Fear God, and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man."
christFocus: Ecclesiastes points to Christ by exposing the emptiness of life apart from God and preparing the heart to find lasting meaning, life, and hope in Him.
outline: Reflections on wisdom and death — Ecclesiastes 7-11
Final call to fear God — Ecclesiastes 12
